contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Victory left issue of 364-375, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: probably DN VALENTI [--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm, uncertain small object in left field. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS [REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 16.2mm, Weight: 1.74gms, die axis: 6
